$description: Fearless Wallet sun-lit neumorphism v2 design tokens (DESIGN-SPEC 2026-11-08; evolved from Neon Glass v1), W3C design-tokens format. The single source for scripts/design/gen-fw-tokens.mjs; never edit the generated platform files.

fw.outputs: Android FwColors.kt + fw_colors.xml, iOS colors/FW/*.colorset + FWTokens.swift, web fw-tokens.scss

crest.$description: Yatagarasu brand kit tokens/colors.json (2026-11-10) and the derived ink steps.

bgBase.$description: Page and every neumorphic surface: brand ink (Yatagarasu, 2026-11-10).

surfaceRaised.$description: Raised-1/Raised-2 surfaces share the page base; depth comes from the light model.

surfaceRaised2.$description: Sheets and dialogs that rise toward the key light.

surfacePressed.$description: Pressed controls sink into an inset well (bgDeep).

surfaceSunken.$description: bgDeep: inset wells, input fields, selected tab well.

glass.$description: Cards are opaque raised surfaces in the sun-lit model.

glassSheen.$description: Retired sheen; the rim light carries the edge.

chrome.$description: Bottom bar, sticky headers, sheets over blur 24 (Full).

chromeSolid.$description: Chrome in Lite or when blur is unavailable.

textSecondary.$description: Secondary lines, captions, HUD overlines, unselected tabs.

textTertiary.$description: Auxiliary text; at least 4.5:1 on every sun-lit surface.

textDisabled.$description: Disabled labels only, with a reason line in text.secondary.

textOnAccent.$description: On primary and danger fills only.

brand.$description: Brand mark and glow, the active tab (Fearless pink #E6006F); kept off buttons with text (4.6:1).

fillTop.$description: Primary fill top (brand rollout spec item 9): white labels read 5.2:1.

fillBottom.$description: Primary fill bottom and pressed primary (spec item 9): white labels read 7.5:1.

accentEdge.$description: 1 px inside edge on fills; lifts the toggle-on track to 3:1.

focus.$description: Focus ring (2 px on a 2 px bg.base offset).

priceUp.$description: Price change up: brand mint #4FF0B8 nudged toward aqua so gains stay at least deltaE 40 from priceDown for protan and deutan viewers (contract cvd); always with the up glyph and sign.

priceDown.$description: Price change down, always with the down glyph and sign.

success.$description: Success glyphs and short state words.

selectEdge.$description: Selected row, chip and pill edge: brand text pink (spec item 9; non-text 3:1).

rowSelected.$description: Selected list row on glass: a brand-pink tint.

rimLight.$description: One-pixel inside rim catching the key light (top, fading by 70 %).

sunRim.$description: Top rim catching the sun bounce; alpha 0-0.35 weighted by distance from the sun.

sunBounce.$description: Warm radial bounce the emissive sun casts onto the page.

sunBounceMid.$description: Sun bounce at half its reach (soft light falloff).

skyAmbient.$description: Ambient sky from the bottom-right corner.

sunCore.$description: Brand gold, the solar motif: the core of the crest badge's glow; emissive accents only.

brandStart.$description: App-icon gradient pink stop (icon background, emissive light).

insetShadow.$description: Inner shadow of wells, top-left (mirrored key light).

emissiveGlow.$description: Outer glow of emissive controls in their own colour.

occlusion.$description: Ambient occlusion: inner corners of wells 8-12 % darker.

brandPressed.$description: Pressed primary action: the fill bottom, solid (spec item 9).

brandInk.$description: Brand ink: launch, splash and welcome surfaces.

brandPlum.$description: Brand plum: the top of brand page gradients.

brandGold.$description: Brand gold: the solar motif and selection marks.

highContrast.$description: Overrides under increased contrast (3.3). Glass, chrome and glow fall back to opaque surfaces in effects code, not tokens.

aurora.$description: Global illumination of the page: the emissive sun bounce and the ambient sky (centre and radius are fractions of the page width/height; radius of the width).

magenta.$description: Sun bounce; centred on the hero sun when one is on screen.

violet.$description: Ambient sky from the bottom-right corner.

statusContainerAlpha.$description: status.*.container: the status colour at this alpha over the current surface (3.2).

rim.$description: light.rim: one-pixel inside edge lit by the key light from above.

brand.$description: brand.gradient: the app-icon gradient's pink and plum (launcher background, emissive sun).

primaryFill.$description: accent.fill: primary button, active toggles (135 degrees, #D6006A to #A8005A, spec item 9).

event.$description: Sun-lit motion (DESIGN-SPEC section 4): every animation reports a real event.

pressIn.$description: Control sinks from raised to inset, scale 0.97.

balanceRoll.$description: Balance digits roll to the new value; changed part tinted up/down.

priceFlash.$description: Row value tint flash on a price change.

syncTurn.$description: One turn of the sync arc while a sync runs.

syncBloom.$description: One bloom of the sun glow when a sync finishes.

syncFail.$description: Sun dims to 60 % and a warning dot appears.

listStagger.$description: Delay between rows on first appearance (at most 8 rows).

listRise.$description: Each row fades in and rises 8 points.

tabWell.$description: The inset well slides under the new tab.

txSuccess.$description: Status ring fills and the check draws.

shake.$description: Two 6 point shakes: failed transaction or wrong PIN.

pinDot.$description: PIN dot fills from the key-light side.

copied.$description: Copy chip glows success with Copied.

reducedCrossfade.$description: Upper bound for crossfades under reduced motion.

web.$description: Element Plus variables bridged to the tokens (6.3).
